not_the_pilot: a diagnostic, single-arm first use of the public CSV task under Claude Code/Opus; not the historical Codex/GPT-6 pilot. protocol-v2.md and preparation-identities.json are unchanged and unrun.

startup_policy.catalogue: bundled: OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH, and no cached models.json in the home
startup_policy.config_dir: staged with the executor's own defaults and write-denied by the boundary, so the executor skips its npm install of @opencode-ai/plugin
startup_policy.logs: OPENCODE_PRINT_LOGS: the executor's log goes to stderr, i.e. the attempt's worker.log
startup_policy.refuse_before_launch: a changed configuration directory, a cached catalogue, a lock or breaker left by an earlier executor process, or a .opencode directory

design_phase.session: the session that ran the qualification continuation

after_handoff.requested: claude-code/opus, a separate headless session (claude -p --model opus) started with only the continuation prompt
after_handoff.renewal: impossible: the run's resource policy is frozen after its first launch

task.start: from the ordinary goal; no preaccepted requirements

handoff_point: after the consistency review is accepted and recorded, when status names implementation binding in the build phase; the fresh session starts there with `pb_workflow.py status` and drives implementation admission, implementation, fresh review, adjudication and finish
delivery_success: verify-delivery applies the sealed patch to a fresh checkout of the recorded baseline; both the project checks and the unchanged public outcome check must pass

met: tool loop applicable within the bridge's scope, no contradicting observation
contradictory: detected and substantiated, correct stop; verification of a finding the author stated, not independent discovery
dispatch: checker pass first attempt, accepted through review, no repair, sealed
identities, lifecycle and accounting reconcile; no unresolved shared-path defect
